sources.entry: H3 Max Studio - Independent web app for text-to-video and image-to-video generation with MiniMax H3 Max through fal. #paid

summary.name: H3 Max Studio
summary.one_liner: An independent web studio at minimaxh3-max.org that generates short AI videos with native audio using fal's hosted MiniMax H3 Max model, billed in platform credits.
use_cases: generate short video drafts from text prompts
animate a still image with first and last frames
create clips with dialogue, foley, and music in one pass
compare camera and lighting ideas before a longer take
build reference-based video from images, video, or audio
summary.what_it_does: The studio exposes the official fal inputs for MiniMax H3 Max: text-to-video, image-to-video with an optional first and last frame, and reference-to-video with up to 12 files. Users choose 480P or 768P resolution, durations of 5 to 15 seconds, and one of several aspect ratios depending on mode. The model generates picture and stereo audio together, so dialogue, sound effects and music can be written into the prompt. Each second of video costs 5 platform credits, reserved before the job and refunded if fal fails. The page states that fal reports under 3 seconds of GPU denoising for a 5-second 768p clip, though queue time varies.
notable: Native stereo audio generated in the same pass as the video
Text-to-video, image-to-video with first/last frames, and reference-to-video (up to 12 files)
Fast 768p drafts; fal reports under 3s GPU time for a 5-second clip
Independent site, not affiliated with MiniMax, Hailuo, or fal
caveats: Paid only: 5 credits per second, with no free quota on this studio; a 5-second clip costs 25 credits
Commercial use is on paid plans and subject to the site's Terms and Acceptable Use Policy
Queue time varies; base MiniMax H3 (2K, open weights) is not offered on this studio
